question: Should OpenClaw accept this shared signed-feed verifier and publisher projection contract before the linked ClawHub producer contracts are frozen and demonstrated end to end?
rationale: The change establishes a core trust boundary shared with official plugin installation, while the producer protocol is explicitly still emerging; selecting when that contract is stable enough to land requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Freeze and prove the contract
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the producer payload contract is stable and actual signed producer output is successfully verified by this consumer.

options.title: Land the decoder slice provisionally
options.body: Accept the strict decoder and shared verifier now, with maintainers explicitly owning possible follow-up churn before the network consumer ships.

recommendation.title: Freeze and prove the contract
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until the producer payload contract is stable and actual signed producer output is successfully verified by this consumer.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent released history most directly connects him to official external plugin catalog and trusted install behavior.
